name: Vampire - Shapechanger - Attempts
description: Flavor text for attempts a feature

results.text: The vampire's form trembles, its essence wrestling with the night's embrace.
A shiver runs through his body as the shadows answer his call.
His bones creak and his flesh ripples like a disturbed grave.
With a hiss of defiance, he fights to shed mortal constraints.
The air grows thick with the scent of decay as transformation begins.
